messages:
rita: Quick heads-up — scheduling a blue->green traffic shift for api-router-eu at 22:15 UTC tonight. Change window 22:15-23:00. Target runtime tag: runtime:v4. Canary has been healthy for ~10h (6 hosts).

noah: ACK. Proposed steps: 1% -> 8% -> 30% -> 70% -> 100%. Holds: 3m, 4m, 6m, 6m. Session cookie TTL 60m. Pin back to previous version for 15m if rollback triggers.

claire: ACK. I'll monitor traces and error budgets. Will enable extra logging for /v1/stream endpoints during rollout.

deploy-bot: Preparing router plan for service `api-router-eu`. Will apply first weight at 22:15:17 UTC.

deploy-bot: STEP 1 -> blue weight=1% at 22:15:18 UTC.

noah: seeing v4 traffic, 200s. p95 ~98ms. error rate 0.01%.

deploy-bot: STEP 2 -> blue weight=8% at 22:18:50 UTC.

claire: small spike in 502s on /v1/stream at 22:19:40 — 0.18% for 1m.

rita: check canary logs — are workers hitting mem pressure?

noah: canaries show increased GC for long seqs but no OOMs. 5xx not sustained.

claire: p95 up +60ms vs baseline but under our 150ms threshold. I'll keep watching.

deploy-bot: STEP 3 -> blue weight=30% at 22:22:55 UTC.

rita: hold — two hosts in gen-pool reported ephemeral 503s around 22:23:10. Not sure if network blip.

infra-bot: Network probe for eu-west1 at 22:23:12 registered transient packet loss on pod host 10. Loss recovered by 22:23:27.

noah: because this was transient, telemetry settled. moving forward per plan.

deploy-bot: STEP 4 -> blue weight=70% at 22:29:05 UTC.

claire: after 70% cut, p95 stabilised ~120ms, errors 0.03% — all green.

deploy-bot: STEP 5 -> blue weight=100% at 22:35:40 UTC. Cutover complete. Pinback window active for 15m.

rita: release notes: runtime:v4 deployed to eu-west1 via staged weighted swap. Canary duration: 10h. Post-cutover checks passed. No rollback required.

infra-bot: Deployment recorded in deploy-log with id DPL-2026-909. Observability retention for this roll set to 72h.

noah: I'll follow up with a mini post-release check at +30m and +2h. Thanks team.

deploy-bot: Rollout completed at 22:35:40 UTC. Auto-rollouts unchanged for tag `runtime:v4`.

rita: closing thread. If we see regressions, reopen and tag INC.
